query: SELECT empresaSlug, SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL)) as total_recorrencia, COUNT(*) as dias_total, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dias_com_valor, MIN(CASE WHEN CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL) > 0 THEN cat9 END) as valor_diario FROM faturamentos WHERE data LIKE '2026-03-%' AND empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE', 'MORUMBI') GROUP BY empresaSlug;
